name: Lineups tab is visible and opens a populated lineups panel on a match page
description: When a visitor opens a match detail permalink and activates the Lineups tab or section, the page reveals a lineups panel that contains both teams' starting players rather than an empty placeholder.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Click the control labeled Lineups (a tab, button, or section header)

Verify a lineups panel becomes visible that contains a home-team starting player list and an away-team starting player list, each holding multiple named player rows rather than an empty or placeholder state
